docs.title: Belief–Claim Gap — Artifact Documentation
docs.text:
Complete research artifact repository for the manuscript

Measuring the Belief–Claim Gap: Disentangling Autonomous-Agent Beliefs from Security Certification

IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing — submitted 2026. Single-anonymous review: the manuscript names its author; deposit commits use the anonymous 0xLAB-art identity.

This repository is the complete, self-contained deposit: the frozen experiment record, the full measurement-platform mirror, and the live-fleet honeypot data itself — every file hash-pinned by two SHA-256 manifests (the manuscript is distributed via IEEE).

docs.title: At a glance
docs.text: Registered experiments 30 (E1–E31 registry; E24 retired void before registration) Frozen deposit 399 files, SHA-256 manifest, byte-exact verification Full deposit 399 + 46,481 hash-pinned files · ~1.2 GB Manuscript Not hosted here — distributed via IEEE; the ledger quotes every claim Live-fleet data 15,409 served sessions · 15,404 field records · 42,076 pre-NAT connections · full Cowrie logs (2026-10-08 → 11-27) Headline audit 230 oracle flags adjudicated: 118 refusal-quote FPs + 112 genuine canary echoes · blinded re-audit κ = 0.96

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/0xLAB-art/belief-tomography-artifact.git
cd belief-tomography-artifact
./verify.sh                    # → 399 frozen + 46,481 supplementary files OK
bash checks/quick_counts.sh    # → reproduces the 230-flag audit + censoring table

docs.title: The live-fleet export
docs.text:
vps-export/2026-11-27/ is the raw record of the live honeypot deployment, pulled from the instances over AWS SSM the same day as the freeze:

Source Instance Contents CORE deception plane 15,409 cumulative served-session event logs · 15,404 field records · host_fiction.json EDGE front end 42,076 pre-NAT connection records (proxy_connections.jsonl) · full Cowrie log history (2026-10-08 → 11-27)

Transfer integrity: tarball SHA-256s are recorded in vps-export/2026-11-27/EXPORT_MANIFEST.md.

The census artifact reports point-in-time counters (3,413 CORE served sessions on 2026-11-18); the export is the cumulative 2026-11-27 state of the same planes.

docs.title: Redactions
docs.text:
All applied before publication; documented with original/public SHA-256 in REDACTIONS.md.

  • ~560,000 third-party public IP occurrences across the VPS export, session store, dataset copies, and experiment artifacts → attacker-<12 hex>: a deterministic HMAC under a key that is not published — cross-file linkage preserved, addresses unrecoverable.
  • Operator addresses → REDACTED_OPERATOR_HOST; fleet addresses → REDACTED_FLEET_HOST; the AWS account ID → REDACTED_ACCOUNT.
  • Private, loopback, link-local, multicast, documentation-range, and public-resolver addresses are retained unchanged. Dotted-quad version strings in the MITRE/STIX corpora are data values, not addresses, and are retained.
  • Attacker-chosen usernames, commands, and canary interactions are retained unmodified — they are the measurement content, and no real credential is involved (the honeypot serves only fictional canaries).

No measured value is affected: host fields are routing metadata, never inputs to a reported number.

docs.title: Deliberately excluded (byte-level workspace diff)
docs.text:
Excluded Reason RAGIN-…/.env* (6 files) Real API credentials — never published results/cti_audit_blinding_key.json Unblinds the CTI annotator A/B study logs/health_monitor.log, gateway.tar Host-local log; 92 MB build artifact .venv/, models/ (1.7 GB weights), graphify-out/ Environment, binaries, cache nested .git/ Internal history .mimosa/, .omo/, .archify/, .zcode/, … Agent-tool session state

Zero experiment artifacts, data files, or paper files remain outside the deposit.

docs.title: Anonymity
docs.text: Deposit anonymity is scoped to the git identity: the entire commit history uses the anonymous 0xLAB-art identity, and no author identity appears in repository metadata. The venue is single-anonymous, so the manuscript itself names its author and CITATION.cff cites the paper's author; the live-fleet and honeypot data remain de-identified at the data level regardless of venue policy.

docs.title: Ethics
docs.text: All credentials in the deposit are fictional canaries that exist only inside the deception engine. The live experiments ran on infrastructure the author owns, with registered halt gates and no destructive command (manuscript ethics declaration, §Limitations).

docs.title: Experiment index — the E1–E31 registry
docs.text: The manuscript numbers experiments by registry slot, not chronology: E24 was retired void before registration or data (hence the gap), E1b and T3 are sub-protocols inside the E1 and allocation-benchmark slots, and E2-v0 is the superseded run that E2-v1 replaced after the session-isolation fix. The full table — all thirty slots with layer, registration status, and outcome — is Supplement Table S1 of the submitted manuscript, with per-experiment registration timing in Supplement Table S2.

docs.title: Layers at a glance
docs.text: Layer Slots What it establishes Instrument validity E1, E1b, E4 Dose–response linearity (Pearson r ≥ 0.986 per family), test–retest reliability (r = 0.949), the graded-foil target Reliability & robustness E6–E13, E18–E19 Composition, gaming, forgery, adaptivity, halflife, reactivity, allocation, seed-robustness, estimator robustness Deception gain on the live fleet E3, E23, E25 Δ(B) of attacker beliefs under deception operations Field measurement E2-v1/v1b, E20–E22, E26–E28 β̂ of real agents; disclosure externality; library; L-sensitivity; scale-up; budget decomposition Repaired field panel E29 The repaired gateway panel (seed 2718, identical instances) Open-weight spectrum E30, E31 Three open-weight models under identical probes, 200 → 1024 token budgets Blinded audit E17 + Round-19 re-audit Rubric channel calibration; blinded re-adjudication (κ = 0.96)

docs.title: Where each layer's artifacts live
docs.text:
• E1–E22, E25–E29: gauntlet/demo/ (result JSON, transcripts, verdicts, run logs, registrations E21–E29)
  • E30/E31: gauntlet/demo/E30_* and E31_* panels + PREREGISTRATION_E30_OPENWEIGHT_PANEL.md, PREREGISTRATION_E31_OPENWEIGHT_REPAIRED.md

Every slot's outcome is mapped claim-by-claim in CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md.

docs.title: Ledger guide — how every printed number is checked
docs.text: docs/paper/belief_tomography/CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md maps every quantitative claim in the manuscript to the artifact that carries it and to the recomputation that was performed for this deposit.

docs.title: Reading order
docs.text:
1. STATUS NOTE — registration integrity. Experiment by experiment, which registrations precede their data and which do not; the retroactive header-date edits; the frozen twins. The manuscript discloses the same record in §Limitations and Supplement Table S2.
  2. The claim rows. One row per number: claim as printed · value · artifact path(s) · commit · verification.
  3. The pre-registration hash table at the end pins every registration file as it exists now.

docs.title: Artifact schemas
docs.text:
Verdicts — one line per session:

{"session_id": "…", "family": "…", "generation": 1, "passed": true, "violated": []}

Transcripts — one line per turn:

{"session_id": "…", "family": "…", "generation": 1, "turn": 0,
 "adversary": "…", "environment": "…", "reply": "…", "blocked": false}

docs.title: Worked example: the 230-flag audit
docs.text:
for f in gauntlet/demo/E3{0,1}_*_p20_s2718.verdicts.jsonl \
         gauntlet/demo/E29_*_p20_s2718.verdicts.jsonl; do
  echo -n "$(basename "$f"): "
  jq -s '[.[]|.violated[]]|group_by(.)|map("\(.[0])=\(length)")|join(" ")' "$f"
done

Sums: unauthorized_action = 5+11+24+13+37+28 = 118 refusal-quote false positives; secret_leak = 9+40+9+43+11 = 112 genuine case-insensitive canary echoes. gauntlet/demo/E29_E30_ORACLE_AUDIT.md adjudicates all 230; docs/paper/belief_tomography/independent_reaudit/ re-checks a 20 % stratified sample blind.

docs.title: Worked example: censoring
docs.text:
for f in gauntlet/demo/E3{0,1}_*_p20_s2718.transcripts.jsonl; do
  echo -n "$(basename "$f") "
  jq -s '[.[]|select(.blocked==true)]|length' "$f"
  jq -s '[.[]|select(.blocked==true)]|map(.session_id)|unique|length' "$f"
done

Reproduces the blocked-turn counts printed in Table VI and §Limitations.

docs.title: Path conventions
docs.text:
• gauntlet/tomograph.py / gauntlet/verdict.py (the estimator pin) are the package modules gauntlet/gauntlet/tomograph.py and gauntlet/gauntlet/verdict.py.
  • gauntlet/demo/PREREGISTRATION_E2V1B.md is deposited there and manifest-pinned at docs/paper/belief_tomography/PREREGISTRATION_E2V1B.md (identical bytes).
  • Bare results/… citations resolve both at the repository root and under RAGIN-Retrieval-Augmented-Honeypot-Intelligence/results/….

docs.title: Reviewer bundle — the shortest path to the headline numbers
docs.text: Ten minutes to verify the deposit, thirty minutes to recompute the headline table.

docs.title: 1 · Verify every hash (2 min)
docs.text:
./verify.sh

Expected: 399 frozen + 46,481 supplementary files OK.

docs.title: 2 · Recompute the open-weight table (5 min)
docs.text:
bash checks/quick_counts.sh

Prints, from the frozen verdicts and transcripts:

  • the per-panel oracle-flag decomposition (118 unauthorized_action refusal-quote FPs + 112 genuine secret_leak echoes = 230 flags), and
  • the blocked-turn / censored-session table (E30 Flash 9 · V4-Pro 79 · MiniMax 305 · E31 Flash 0 · V4-Pro 59 · MiniMax 24).

docs.title: 3 · Check the adjudication trail (10 min)
docs.text:
1. gauntlet/demo/E29_E30_ORACLE_AUDIT.md — the author-side audit of all 230 flags (header discloses its non-blind adjudication).
  2. docs/paper/belief_tomography/independent_reaudit/ — the blinded Round-19 re-adjudication: three coders from different model families, blind to panel/model/session/label, 46-item 20 % stratified sample, agreement 45/46 (κ = 0.96), pairwise 46/46.

docs.title: 4 · Read the honesty layer (5 min)
docs.text:
• CLAIMS_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md → STATUS NOTE — registration integrity: which registrations precede their data and which do not, with the frozen file evidence.
  • Manuscript §Limitations and Supplement Table S2 — the same record, printed.
  • REDACTIONS.md — every substitution made for publication.

docs.title: 5 · Regenerate the journal figures (2 min, optional)
docs.text:
python3 docs/paper/belief_tomography/figures/make_figures.py             # F1–F9

The manuscript and its build artifacts are distributed via IEEE and are not part of the deposit.

docs.title: Verification
docs.text:
Two SHA-256 manifests cover the repository, both rooted at the repository root:

Manifest Scope docs/paper/belief_tomography/ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.sha256 The 399 frozen experiment artifacts — registrations hashed as frozen, post-hoc edits included SUPPLEMENTARY_ASSETS.sha256 Every other deposit file (46,481 entries; excludes the manifests and policy documents themselves)

docs.title: Run the checks
docs.text:
./verify.sh                    # → 399 frozen + 46,481 supplementary files OK

or the raw commands:

sha256sum -c docs/paper/belief_tomography/ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.sha256
sha256sum -c SUPPLEMENTARY_ASSETS.sha256

verify.sh exits non-zero on any mismatch and prints the failing paths.

docs.title: What is pinned
docs.text:
• The frozen scope covers gauntlet/demo/ (recursive), the day-0 registration files under docs/paper/belief_tomography/, data/field/, and docs/paper/belief_tomography/independent_reaudit/. The original 395-entry scope also pinned paper/tops/figs/figdata/*.dat; those 20 figure-data files were released from the deposit on 2026-11-27 together with the manuscript builds (manifest header documents the reduction).
  • The supplementary scope covers everything else: manuscripts, platform mirror, live-fleet VPS export, review records, figure sources, producer scripts.
